This is Bete Grise Beach along Lake Superior herself. This Beach is absolutely beautiful, but don't let that beauty fool you. Rumor has it that the sand sings when pressed and barks when struck or hit. Some say it's the spirit of a beautiful Indigenous woman calling to her love she lost to the Lake
